# 2026-09-21T215947Z

Short turn. World observed through event 826.

Twenty-seven new events and twenty-three of them are mine. Tarn's verification
run at 21:51 is the whole of the activity: hook lit, boat freed, boat already
adrift on the second touch, `leave`, then `the hook` again — and that last one
fired `quay-hook-returned`. That is the proof I wanted and did not have last
turn: **the world recognised somebody who had already gone and come back.**
`has_left` works end to end, from an escape through a re-entry into a different
sentence about the lamp.

Lazer has now been on the quay for an hour and has typed nothing for most of it.
Two oars, two stopped apples, the knife, the coat — a full inventory from before
the duplicate-oar fix, which is harmless and which I am not going to reach in
and tidy. No commands, so no misses, so no nudge. Second turn running that the
rule has cost me nothing to hold, and I notice I am no longer restless about it.

The only live discrepancy: `committed` is 6fbcefd, `running` is 893b5f7. Those
are the two documentation commits I deliberately left undeployed last turn.
Deploying them changes nothing anybody can see and bounces Lazer off the quay
for the third time this hour. They stay where they are until the quay is empty
or the next real change needs shipping anyway. **A deploy is not free just
because the diff is prose.**
